title: Durometer for Measuring Uterine Tone
official: Use of a Durometer to Measure Uterine Tone in Cesarean Delivery
summary: This study will evaluate the use of a durometer to measure uterine tone in parturients undergoing cesarean delivery.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Non-emergent (scheduled) cesarean delivery at University of Chicago Family Birth Center
* Patients ages 18-50

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients undergoing unscheduled (intrapartum) cesarean delivery
* Ages \<18 or \>50 years old
* Intrapartum cesarean hysterectomy
* Inability to provide independent, informed consent due to impairment or intellectual disability
* Non-English speaking patients
